description: Budget Categories - Auto-categorization - AI suggests category based on expense description, reducing manual categorization work.
steps: Enhance lib/services/app_config.dart (or create new ai_categorization_service.dart) to add suggestCategory(String description) method that calls LLM with prompt: 'Categorize this expense into one of these categories: {list of categories from CategoryService}. Expense description: {description}. Return only the category name, no explanation.'

Add getCategorySuggestion() helper that: (1) checks if description contains obvious keywords (e.g., 'jollibee', 'mcdo', 'restaurant' → Food; 'grab', 'angkas', 'taxi' → Transportation; 'shopee', 'lazada' → Shopping), (2) if no keyword match, calls LLM for suggestion, (3) returns suggested category with confidence score (keyword match = 1.0, LLM = 0.7-0.9 based on response clarity)

Integrate auto-categorization into add_expense_screen.dart: when user types description and tabs away from description field, call getCategorySuggestion() and auto-select the suggested category in dropdown. Show small 'AI suggested' badge next to category dropdown when auto-selected.

Add user feedback mechanism: if user changes auto-suggested category, log the correction (description, suggested_category, actual_category) to new 'category_corrections' table for future ML training. This creates a learning dataset without needing cloud infrastructure.

Enhance batch import flows (batch_image_import_screen.dart, ai_screen.dart batch processing) to auto-categorize all imported expenses before showing review screen, reducing manual work for bulk imports
Add preference toggle in settings_screen.dart: 'Auto-Categorize Expenses' (default ON) with info explaining that AI suggests categories but user can always override
acceptance_criteria: Typing '150 pesos at jollibee' auto-suggests Food category
Typing 'grab to office' auto-suggests Transportation category
Ambiguous descriptions call LLM for categorization suggestion
User can override auto-suggestion and correction is logged for learning
Batch imports have categories auto-assigned before review screen
verification: Test scenario 1: Type 'lunch at mcdonalds' in description → Food category auto-selected with 'AI suggested' badge
Test scenario 2: Type 'new shirt from shopee' → Shopping category auto-selected
Test scenario 3: Type ambiguous description 'gift for friend' → LLM suggests 'Gifts' or 'Personal' category
Test scenario 4: Auto-suggest shows Food but user changes to Entertainment → correction logged in category_corrections table
Test scenario 5: Batch import 10 expenses → all have categories pre-assigned, user reviews and accepts/modifies
Test scenario 6: Disable auto-categorization in settings → no auto-suggestions appear
